card.name: Final letters of new brand drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a newly coined brand drug name, such as the Y in IMAAVY or the VI in KYGEVVI, in label text. It also fires on the Y in names right after a CONTRAINDICATIONS heading.

modes.label: End of brand name
modes.description: Closing letters of an invented brand name used as the drug's name in dosing and warning text.
modes.example: Administer the diluted IMAAV<<Y>> solution immediately after preparation.

modes.label: Name after contraindications heading
modes.description: The Y that opens or sits inside a brand name right after the contraindications section number.

card.plain: It marks the last letters of unfamiliar brand drug names in prescribing information.
